description.zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.
The ID of the Edge Routine that you want to query.

description.zh:
查询指定的边缘函数规格。取值：

- 5ms

- 50ms

- 100ms
description.en:
The specification of the Edge Routine. Valid values:

- 5ms

- 50ms

- 100ms

description.zh:
查询结果分组输出，可以按照函数ID（routine）或函数规格（spec）分组输出。

>若参数为空，查询结果不分组。
description.en:
The dimension by which you want to group the query results. You can group the results by Edge Routine ID (routine) or specification (spec).

> If you leave this parameter empty, the query results are not grouped.

description.zh: 获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 查询边缘函数ER的执行次数

descriptions.zh:
> 
> - 单用户调用频率：10次/秒。
> - 支持查询的最小时间粒度为1小时；查询的最大时间跨度为24小时；可查询最大历史数据时间范围为366天。
descriptions.en:
> - The call frequency for a single user is limited to 10 calls per second.
>
> - The minimum time granularity for a query is 1 hour. The maximum time span for a query is 24 hours. You can query data within the last 366 days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-er-usage-data --routine-id routine1.test --spec 50ms --start-time 2018-10-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-10-31T16:00:00Z --split-by routine --region cn-hangzhou
